title: Beef Stroganoff Pilaf
description: A hearty, comforting pilaf dish with tender beef and a rich, savory sauce.

ingredients.name: beef
ingredients.notes: sirloin steak, cut into bite-sized strips

ingredients.name: pilaf
ingredients.notes: dried rice and herb pilaf mix

instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium-high heat.
Add beef and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove beef from pan and set aside.
Add onion and mushroom to pan and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add beef broth and stir to combine.
Return beef to pan and simmer until cooked through, about 10 minutes.
Stir in pilaf mix and cook according to package instructions.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh dill.
